semantics.transition: out_next = out_previous XOR in sampled at the positive edge
semantics.between_edges: out holds its stored value, including on falling edges and input changes
semantics.initialization: No specified initial state; do not initialize the DUT. Four-state simulation starts out unknown.
semantics.latency: Stored output updates after each positive edge using nonblocking assignment semantics

numeric.unknowns: Standard four-state XOR propagates X/Z to an unknown result

verification.compile: Icarus -g2012 with explicit dev_tb top and finite timeout
verification.initial_state: Check uninitialized out is X and remains X across binary input edges
verification.known_state: Testbench-only deposit of both possible stored values between edges, then independently expect hold for in=0 and toggle for in=1
verification.edge_coverage: Check input changes and falling edges do not change stored output; sample after NBA on positive edges
verification.four_state: Check X and Z input produce unknown output
verification.completion: Self-checking fatal failures, explicit PASS marker and watchdog
